responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Allison,
We're deeply saddened to hear about your disappointment. We appreciate your feedback and are committed to making improvements. Your comments will be taken seriously as we strive to regain your trust and restore the quality you once loved.

We hope you'll give us another chance to provide you with the excellent service and quality food that we are known for.
Best Regards
La Casita
Sandra.
text:
I have been visiting La Casita for a number of years & have never been disappointed ; tonight (11/04) was the exception. The starters of cheese fries & chilli jam, calamari & garlic prawns were a mixed level of tastiness - the best were the prawns (lots of garlic butter which was great), the worst were the calamari (these were inedible & returned). The waiter did apologise & removed this item from the bill. We did order some pão caseiro bread (traditional Portuguese bread) after the starters were served - this was definitely NOT pão caseiro - very disappointing. The mains consisted of mixed fish skewer (espetada), baked salted cod (bacalhau ) & sirloin steak - all 3 were below par. The steak was NOT sirloin, it was a largish flat piece of beef with a fair amount of “flobby” fat smothered with peppercorn sauce. Half of the steak was edible & the fries & side salad were good. The bacalhau was overcooked, way too firm not soft & silky & dry to taste ; the accompanying vegetables were good. The worse was the espetada ; the tuna was hard & grey in colour, the calamari was the same as the starter, difficult to cut & “rubbery”, the prawns were near on impossible to peel as they were stuck to the shell, the salmon was hard & dry. Along with the vegetables, the whole skewer was burnt / extremely charred. Around 75% of the food was left on our plates. The waiter did ask if everything was ok when clearing our table, we did respond giving an overall opinion that everything was overcooked. Not too much conversation between us, he acknowledged & left. The bill didn’t reflect any other discount apart from the calamari starter.
Maybe an “off” night for the Chef but @ our detriment & £££ ; not good. No one goes out to have a bad / unsatisfactory meal but this was probably one of the worst meals we’ve had in a long time. NB the photo’s can & are deceiving - the food looks good but tasted the complete opposite.

responseFromOwnerText: Dear Victoria, Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We're sorry to hear that your recent visit wasn't up to your expectations. We take all feedback seriously, and we appreciate your honest feedback.
text:
I had a very bizarre and odd experience at this restaurant. The atmosphere was empty and cold, with sterile and basic décor. Despite my sister's praises about the food being well-priced, I found it to be average at best. The prawn starter was basic and the corn-fed chicken with chips was nothing to write home about. The seasoning was sharp and left a strange sensation in my mouth.

However, the saving grace of the night was our waitress, Bruna. She was friendly, attentive, and truly the life of the restaurant. Despite the lack of customers, she made us feel welcome and took great care of us. We ended up staying longer than planned, enjoying multiple jugs of sangria and other drinks.

To my shock and disappointment, I later found out that Bruna had been fired for "talking too much." This decision seemed unjust and heartless, especially considering she was the only staff member who seemed to care about the guests. The restaurant lacked any music or atmosphere, making it a depressing place to dine.

I can't help but feel that there were racist undertones at play here, as the restaurant seemed to be trying to cater to a specific audience. Treating a young, hardworking employee like Bruna in such a manner is unacceptable. It's clear that this establishment is not a fine dining restaurant, even though they are obviously straining to be and I am horrified by the way they treated someone who went above and beyond to make our night enjoyable. Shame on them for ruining what could have been a pleasant experience and be warned they obviously have no respect or care about their staff.

text:
Had ordered from La Casita quite often during the pandemic and found their food to be absolutely delicious.

However, my partner and I had recently ordered again and we were really disappointed with what we had recieved (poor quality food and small portion sizes). I had subsequently left a bad review expressing my disappointment.

The restaurant reached out to me directly offering to redo the order. Having recieved this, I can say the portion size was a lot better and what we would expect.

My only concern is I do think the quality of the food on this occasion was not as good compared to our previous orders. Mainly the meat which was average. Perhaps a personal preference but I did have quite a bit of fat in my meat which wasn't great and my partner's steak still thin and lacked flavour. For the food I would probably go at 3.5 out of 5 (previously a 5* during pandemic).

However, overall, I will leave the restaurant with 4 stars as their customer service was outstanding and they did look to rectify where they went wrong last time to the point that they even went out their way to deliver to me themselves. They seemed very sorry for what had happened to our previous order and I accept their apology.

My only advice to the restaurant is to please keep an eye on quality control with the meat that's being sourced and how it's being cooked as I'm pretty sure there's been a negative change here compared to when we ordered back in 2020/21 (perhaps new staff? Change of supplier?).

Service was abysmal.

text:
Alright hear me now, this is a quick and snappy food review just some acknowledgment for this Lebanese grill in streatham hill called Roots. Beautiful interior, definitely aesthetically pleasing enough if you want to go here for a quick birthday lunch. Beautiful but simplistic food which you can’t go wrong with. I got the mixed grill which was £17.25 so not too expensive.

Shish Taouk
Which is basically seasoned chicken cubes. Most of the chicken cubes were succulent, seasoned well but a bit salty, one was a bit dry but we can ignore it since it was an anomaly.

Lamb Kafta -  tender, flavoursome, meat that wasn’t overly seasoned so the taste of the meat it self was still present and the most prominent which I believe is the is the point. To let the real flavour of the meat to show through. Fantastic stuff !

Lamb skewers were also flavoured well, weren’t chewy which is always a risk with that particular type of meat. It was the best lamb skewer I’ve had in some time. Very enjoyable !

The season rice was just beautiful, delicate and a great side to all that meat and definitely well flavoured which is a continuous theme for this restaurant.

Overall rating 7.5/10

For more reviews check my insta sjtalks_

I am a lover of Shawarma, hugely, and have been for close to 16 years now and the one made here at Roots was as good as any that I’ve had elsewhere in London eg Marble Arch, Camberwell, Norbury and several other places.

But when you combine great food with funny, friendly and a warm service, then we know that food tastes so much better.

Roots’ food was like having a great meal at home cooked with love and laughter.

The Owner and his Daughter run an establishment that should be in the City with a 50% premium on their prices … but I’m so glad they’re not as they are just around the corner from me with prices for the ordinary folk.

Anyway, if they keep this wonderfully high standard of food going, they’ll have enough to open a new restaurant up town as well and keep Roots Streatham too hopefully.

If you’re reading this review then all I can say is it was worth every penny.

I went to ROOTS as 2 of my friends spoke very highly of this labanese restaurant. I ordered a Mix Grill with wings as I heard their wings are very nice. The wings were absolutely delicious 👌🏽👌🏽👌🏽 as well as the rest of the meat. Everything was sizzling hot and everything had a nice taste. The pitter bread that came with the mix grill was nice and soft and had a nice little filling inside which contained onions.

I had a Roots passion fruit Martini cocktail which was really good. However there was no sign of a passion fruit inside my cocktail! 🤦🏽‍♀️😩. It looked like I had Fanta inside my cocktail glass with a few ice cubes lol 🤦🏽‍♀️. At £9.50 I would have expected my cocktail to look a bit more like a cocktail ☺️.

The customer service was good, and the lady even came back over to ask if our cocktail was ok & if we wanted another one.

Overall I was very impressed with the food. I will definitely be visiting again! I think ROOTS is a hidden gem in Streatham 😊. I would rate this place 9/10. The lady waiter has excellent customer service… 👌🏽

text: We got the set menu for 4, which included a variety of mezze starters, two mixed grills, a bottle of house wine and some baklava. One of us was a vegetarian who was offered moussaka or a okra stew as an alternative, but as he didn’t like those options we were offered an alternative option to choose a couple of sides instead at no extra cost which was very kind. We also had someone in our party who had a nut allergy and they were very attentive to this. It was ALOT of food, so well worth the cost in my opinion! The bottle of wine was upgraded and we also got a free Lebanese coffee at the end which was a nice touch! Lovely flavours (especially the lemony chicken wings), great friendly service, perhaps one of the best I’ve experienced in a long time in London, and really cool decor inside. Will be visiting again as we live so close!

We stumbled along this place whilst trying to find a place to eat. We decided to go in as it was a new restaurant in Streatham.

We were greeted by the lovely waiter, who guided us to our seat. The menu had a large variety of Lebanese food which included hot mezzeh and cold mezzeh. I have some issues with food in general, and the chefs were very accommodating and met my requirements. I enjoyed my meal a lot. We were actually being served by the owner, who is a very lovely person.

After a few visits , we fell in love with their garden and decided to have my birthday party there!  Which ended up to be, the party of the season for all my family & friends! At the party we had 25 people plus parents , we had some cold platter mezzeh and the kids had chicken, rice, chips and salad. Everybody enjoyed it , including parents!

Overall, I recommend this place to everyone who wants to go there, the food is fantastic, the atmosphere is great, the owner is nice  and the service is wonderful.

Dear Mr Mahrez
We at Sahara care about our customers reviews … sorry if your visit wasn’t as you wished and that’s can be fixed .

text:
I always try to support local businesses and thought I would give this place a try but never again. I ordered two falafel wraps at this place during my lunch break to take back home for my wife and I. When paying at the till I got asked if I wanted the lunch time deal of £5.95 which included a wrap and a drink. I politely declined as I just wanted a wrap. When paying for the wraps the guy at the till went to charge me for the £11.90 for the lunch time deal. I told him that I didn't want the deal and he then proceeded to "change" the amount to £11. As I paid for the wraps I got a notification that £11.90 was taken from my card. He never changed the amount.

The pure cheekines to gain just an extra 90p for a sale has cost this place a customer as I actually enjoyed the wrap. When I mentioned that he has still charged me for the extra he acted as if he had done nothing wrong and it is just ridiculous the extent people go to. Treat the customer fairly and they will return. I can now see why this place is always empty.

Nice ambience with both bench and table seating. Service was efficient and quick.
Good size portions and the first mouthful took me back to the taste of local food in Thailand. A definite recommendation in itself. My tasty vegetarian rice dish was served in a wooden box that kept it hot throughout the meal.
Unfortunately there were few pure vegetarian choices (some of the choices are helpfully flagged up on the menu with a symbol denoting the presence of fish/shrimp in the cooking), only one or two if you don't want spicy food.
Despite the above, I would go back again to eat. I went on a whim, sat down, ordered food, food came, it was good, very satisfying, paid and left. Exactly what I wanted.
Not a place for an intimate date over a lingering meal but good place to grab a meal.

text:
I have been to the Slurp restaurant several times before and recommended it to family and friends, mainly because I have generally been happy with the food. The service, however, has always been indifferent, a bit hit and miss, where the staff sometimes forget part of your order or they lack a reasonable level of good quality service, almost to the point where you have to show them what to do, (all in good spirit) i.e. a right handed person serving you on your left side and exposing you to their arm pit and smelling body odor (ghastly stuff).

My last two visits have been worrying in that having ordered rice (among other things) and upon eating it found that it was not right, the texture was spongy and it had no taste. I had to return it on both occasions. The Manager (male) apologized, removed it from the bill and brought a dessert as a gesture free of charge (good man). It is because of the manager and his desire to provide good service if things go wrong, the reason why I returned to this restaurant.

My most recent visit, however, was a disaster. The manager was not there on this occasion and all hell broke loose. I made my usual order but the rice was just not right. I literally only ate 2 or 3 small bite size portions for taste and it was just spongy with little or no taste. I asked the waitress (black girl) to take it away.

When I received the bill, the Chinese lady who appeared to be in charge insisted I pay for the rice because she claimed I had eaten over half of it.This was simply not true and she was clearly 'reaching'. She then called the waitress (black girl) who became animated and shouted at me saying I've returned the rice on 2 previous occasions, which only endorsed my previous concerns that perhaps there is something wrong or something more sinister with the rice.

But what was most outrageous and completely unacceptable was not only what was being said to me by both staff members, but the sheer aggression and ignorant manner they exhibited. They stood over me whilst I was sitting at the table and shouted in ear shot of other guests saying I must pay for the rice. I was utterly shocked and numb by their behavior. I felt bullied and utterly humiliated. I was given the option of paying the full bill or told not to come back. Needless to say, I will not be going back and will be informing my family and friends of this incident. You may like the rice, I didn't.

Visited February 2017

Small compact nightclub filled with people from all cultures mainly afro carribean and Africàn and a splash of English people.

Not a place for those who like a spacious dance floor to practice their John Travolta moves.  More like a mini nightclub!

This club is full of loud reggae music with a hint of soul and calypso music belting out music to feed the ears of the varied revellers inside.

As the club is not of size, if packed there is not much room to Manoeuvre or dance so revellers can get rude and just graze past you without a mèntion of excuse, please or thànk you.

If you can turn a blind eye to some bad behaviour, loud music and accommodate minimal dancing space.  This club can be a memorable experience for you.

Don't just take my word for it.  Make your way to Streatham and come and ènter Porky's get a taste of the Caribbean vibe.

Good luck, you may need it. 😁

text:
Went with two teens to try out the mini golf on a Sunday afternoon. Honestly - terrible! I'll start with arrival and then explain the 7 hole course.

On arrival, met with a really unenthusiastic unsmiling lady behind the bar who seemed to be more interested in her conversation with her pal sat drinking at the bar than in engaging with what few customers they had. We weren't shown to the course - we were given balls piece of paper and pencil and left to get on with it. I ordered 2 sprites which was £7.

Hole 2 had broken glass in one of the holes that you were supposed to putt through. Luckily for us a couple before us had warned us in time - I dread to think what would have happened if they had not had the forethought! The staff certainly didn't seem to care.

The course itself was abysmal, really poorly laid out and not at all fun or imaginative - we invented our own "rules" to make it somewhat fun. Sometimes the end hole was right next to where you started from - and only one obstacle which wasn't actually in line - but you could infer you were supposed to follow that line. Hole 6 I believe we found a discarded false nail on the course - and Hole 7 huge letdown - no real challenge fun at the end.

Overall, this could have been a lot better. We were there at 5pm on a Sunday - sure after a Saturday night, but you'd think the staff would have cared to have cleaned up by then. Tables and floors felt sticky and there were mop buckets of stank water left around. My son slipped on a bit and touched a gross looking wet floor.

There were a couple of old arcade machines we had a couple of gos at - but the most fun was the air hockey table which was not free and cost £1.50 a go - my teens played 2 games.

So overall spend - mini golf - £10 adult + £16 2 kids + £3 air hockey + £7 2 sprites = £36.

I would not recommend and would not ever go back - much better to travel in to Puttshack.

Honestly only 2 stars because we did spend about 60mins and there was an Air hockey machine

text:
Wanted to go here for a while now. After reading the reviews wanted to test it out before taking a large crowd of us there. When i look at review with such contrasting views its clear that something isnt right. After a quick visit (i do mean quick, under an hour). It clears the 5 star ratings must be friends of the bar, which is why it was so empty when we visited recently. Cant talk about the staff, as apart from paying £29 for two people to play golf with a soft drink and a wine. We didnt see or speak to any one esle.
Venue:
Has the look of a youth centre but without the atmosphere or people. Everything is quashed into every available space. There is everything your kids to play, but like every Youth centre its all falling apart or badly put together.
Mini Golf:
The first three hole occupy the same space as the dart board. For safety both shouldn't be played at the same time. As you can see from the pictures it looks like they went to B&Q bought the cheapest fake grass, some pipes and off cut timber. No time has been taken to consider game play. The hole dont tell you how to take the shot (like every other miningolf i have ever played). Although being so small its not hard to work it out. They have used the wrong pile, and the grass  length impedes the balls travel. Just dont hit it to hard or it may injure someone. If you manage to get the ball to move across the grass the holes are so badly put together that we had to help it through the "tunnel". We had to lift the grass and put it theough the pipe in order to get our ball out. The ring 4 holes, yes only 7 holes for your money, were downstairs. The double loop in the vault again lined with grass slow the ball down enough the make it impossible to complete the loops. Then there are two very steep inclines, the first has karaoke seating beside it. Again be careful seating here. Thankfully it was empty when we was there. The second was soo tight that you could barely to in.
I feel it has taken me longer to write this review, then it did to play the mini golf.
Conclusion i wont be bringing the group here,  Glad I did a recki first, Streatham has such a great night life, shame Putt Putt cant be apart of that.

text:
This is one of the worst places I’ve ever been to. I booked in for Karaoke via a Wowcher, when we got there, the karaoke room was already filled with a private party. Someone was having a full blown birthday party, full food spread table, banners, balloons the works! The manager came down and told them we would be using the room too and we could play one song each for the night, except they weren’t there for singing. So we sang one song and they would choose one song to dance to and that’s how it played out.
They were very nice people and very patient with our singing interrupting their private party. He said they had changed the way they run the place, there are no private rooms anymore and this is how they run now.

The actual Karaoke itself was us choosing a song from YouTube and singing along and they didn’t even have premium so we had to watch an advert between each song. I think this annoyed me the most, if you are going to advertise as a venue for karaoke, even one who just uses YouTube (which in itself is ridiculous) pay for premium!

It was shockingly bad, we could’ve done this at home, at least we wouldn’t have any adverts and wouldn’t be interrupting someone else’s birthday party!

As we were singing and probably annoying the other group, people would be playing mini golf right in the way of the screen. One of the mini golf holes was the stairs…

Because it wasn’t a private room and we were sharing the YouTube with another group, a guy walked in, who was really drunk and started singing weird songs and talking about sex and swearing. It took a long time to work out he was a random and not with the other group, they thought he was with us. We had to remove him ourselves.

It was the most ridiculous night out I’ve ever had. It was so bad that it was almost funny. Except it was a suprise birthday party for my husband so I’m pretty annoyed but he found it funny.

I will say this, I bought my Wowcher in August and it expired on 17th September and they let me come on 8th October which was a lovely thing to do, so that’s why they are getting 2 stars, otherwise it would be one.

Avoid this place.

text: Not a great experience. As fancy as the place looks from the outside, this business is not up to expectations: the website does not offer any reminiscence of the actual place and it is misleading -not a single picture is the actual place and they claim to be the "biggest indoor crazy golf in London" while in reality is the biggest disappointment in Streatham. While booking the gold course is quite easy online, the confirmation email does not even say date or time -simply a 10am to 11.30pm booking, when they do not really open that early. You will not know if you did the booking correctly. The phone provided does not work and they do not reply to emails. I had to actually go and double check that the reservation was okay for the day and the person at front simply said "sure, come in any time". They did not check the reservation when returning -assuming they remember me from when I went to check my booking was correct?-, and simply handle a couple of golf balls and the points sheet. There are two levels: 7 holes upstairs -only worth the first 3, being number 3 a really hard one- and another 7 wholes downstairs. Most of the wholes need to be redesign as they do not have any hints nor explanation and I had a feeling that the design is not calculated to be fun but rather challenging by the shake of it. They basically do not comply with physics rules. Downstairs remains more of a Saw film than a mini golf course. They have utilised the warehouse area to make it look a "money heist" course, but it is an actual "warehouse" course, with several doors locked and unsigned, confusing holes and arrows, and a "crafty" design with materials that are closer to an "art attack" project than a professional business. Neil Buchannan's paper mâché was for sure stronger than some of the materials in Putt Putt. Staplers are all over the place and there are risks of accidents, specially downstairs with the poor light and stairs around. It could be one of those experiences that it is so bad that it is fun, but not for £20 per person (or £10 upstairs/£15 upstairs). Not worth it. The bar area is as wide as an airplane corridor, aside two tables areas -one next to a ping pong table and one right in the middle of a hole downstairs. I cannot talk about the drinks or food as we left as soon as possible -around 20 minutes course for £20 if you actually try to ace in every hole (good luck). No Karaoke room on site. No cloakroom either so be ready to carry your belongings around the narrow course. Upsetting.

text:
Disappointing Service on a Special Occasion

I’ve always enjoyed dining at Marinatto, as their Brazilian dishes, especially the Brazilian style pizza, are consistently delicious. However, my recent visit on 15/04 for my birthday left a lot to be desired in terms of service.

While I was looking forward to celebrating with some great food and a cake my brother brought, the experience was marred by the handling of the cake. After asking a waiter to bring it out, he simply placed the bag with the cake in the middle of the table without any effort to present it nicely. We didn’t expect much, just a bit of common sense, like taking the cake out of the box, or at the very least, lighting the candles. I had to borrow a lighter from the table next to us! Plates were provided after they saw me asking the lighter for the next table.

Although we ended up paying for the service because our waitress was pleasant, the male staff member who dropped the bag on our table clearly doesn’t understand what good service entails. It’s a shame as simple things can change the experience. I hope they can improve their service in the future.

responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Eric,
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! 🌟 We're thrilled to hear that you enjoyed your dining experience with us. Our team works hard to provide delicious food and exceptional service, and it’s incredibly rewarding to know we hit the mark for you.

We look forward to welcoming you back soon. If there’s anything we can do to make your next visit even more enjoyable, please don’t hesitate to let us know.

text:
Pleasant addition to Streatham Hill dining scene.

Have to say I was pleased with the warmth of the greeting we received upon arrival. This wasn’t just professional/friendly, it made me feel that we were truly being welcomed.

Came thinking I’d have a pizza, but couldn’t get excited about any of the pizza combinations on offer.  Instead, I opted for the individual picanha (rump steak) served with a generous hunk of cheesy garlic bread.  Tasty, and well prepared, though I wish there had been some sort of side vegetables to accompany, or even a vegetable side on the menu other than a salad I could have ordered.  My dining companion had the feijoada which was also quite nice.  I’m not a feijoada connoisseur, but Marinatto’s was as good as I’ve eaten in Brazil. House red was smooth and reasonably priced.  Only disappointment of the meal was the starter of jalapeño balls.   I’m not sure if these are made in-house or frozen, but I suspect the latter.  Biggest problem was an almost total absence of jalapeños. My companion honestly thought that we’d been served an order of cheese balls instead (see photo).

Total meal for two including wine and service £61.11.

Eu estive com minha esposa no Domingo 28/07/24 por volta das 16:00 e realmente foi decepcionante e frustrante o nosso atendimento. Inicialmente enquanto minha esposa olhava o cardápio, eu pedi um guaraná com gelo e laranja ou limão para a garçonete Agata mas esse guaraná demorou muito, quando minha esposa chamou o garçom e pediu uma corona e para minha surpresa logo em seguida a corona chegou na mesa e nada do guaraná chegar, foi quando eu resolvi reclamar da demora do guaraná e a Agata me respondeu que eles estavam preparando o guaraná que eu pedi. Se a bebida demorou desse jeito resolvemos fazer o nosso pedido, Eu pedi um bacalhau com natas e minha esposa uma feijoada. Depois de esperarmos mais de 40 minutos a comida veio somente a feijoada (se eh que se pode chamar aquilo de feijoada, porque para um restaurante Brasileiro chamar aquilo de feijoada só pode ser brincadeira. Bom fiquei esperando meu bacalhau com natas e nada dele vir, " de repente estavam trazendo o bacalhau com natas de Lisboa...:((( , Quando minha esposa já tinha praticamente terminado de almoçar, quando ela chamou o garçom de nome Lucas e perguntou do bacalhau com natas que não veio para a mesa ate aquele momento e ele foi verificar e quando voltou a mesa nos falou que o bacalhau com natas não tinha sido incluído no nosso pedido ou seja depois de estar ali sentado 1 hora o meu bacalhau com natas que fora anotado pela garçonete Agata não chegou a nossa mesa. Foi então que eu pedi outra feijoada porque além de estar com fome e muito P____ da vida com esse péssimo atendimento, a outra feijoada também demorou. Após comer a feijoada, eu pedi a conta e o garçom veio me cobrou a conta e nem se quer me pediu desculpa pelo que aconteceu e foi quando o garçom Lucas chegou na mesa e eu falei com ele que estávamos muito desapontados com o serviço do restaurante Marinato. Alias horrível o serviço, uma bagunça, funcionários desorganizados e sem treinamento nenhum. A essa hora no mínimo o gerente ou responsável pelo Marinato deveria aparecer na nossa mesa mas nem isso aconteceu. Falei para o Lucas que aquele restaurante era muito mau gerenciado e administrado e sem contar que a musica ambiente estava muito alta, quando as pessoas vão no restaurantes elas gostam de conversar mas com aquela musica alta não tem como.
Se realmente vocês querem melhorar o serviço de vocês eh preciso investir em treinamento, gerenciamento  e administração porque do jeito que esta, vocês não tem futuro não.
Com certeza se alguém me perguntar se eu recomendo o Marinato - Logico que não.
textTranslated:
I was with my wife on Sunday 07/28/24 around 4:00 pm and our service was really disappointing and frustrating. Initially, while my wife was looking at the menu, I ordered a guarana with ice and orange or lemon from the waitress Agata, but the guarana took a long time. When my wife called the waiter and asked for a corona, to my surprise, the corona arrived at the table and the guarana still hadn't arrived. That's when I decided to complain about the delay in the guarana and Agata told me that they were preparing the guarana that I had ordered. Well, finally the guarana arrived. ( In my mind I think they went to get the guaraná from Brazil...:(((
If the drink took that long we decided to place our order. I ordered cod with cream and my wife ordered feijoada. After waiting more than 40 minutes the food only came, the feijoada (if you can call it feijoada, because for a Brazilian restaurant to call it feijoada can only be a joke). Well, I waited for my cod with cream and it never arrived, "suddenly they were bringing the cod with cream from Lisbon...:((( , When my wife had practically finished eating, when she called the waiter named Lucas and asked about the cod with cream that had not come to the table until that moment and he went to check and when he came back to the table he told us that the cod with cream had not been included in our order, that is, after sitting there for 1 hour my cod with cream that had been noted by the waitress Agata did not arrive at our table. So I ordered another feijoada because, besides being hungry and really pissed off about the terrible service, the other feijoada also took a long time. After eating the feijoada, I asked for the bill and the waiter came and charged me for the bill and didn't even apologize for what happened. That's when the waiter Lucas came to the table and I told him that we were very disappointed with the service at the Marinato restaurant. In fact, the service was horrible, a mess, the employees were disorganized and had no training whatsoever. At that time, the manager or person in charge of the Marinato restaurant should have come to our table at the very least, but that didn't happen. I told Lucas that the restaurant was very poorly managed and administered, and not to mention that the background music was too loud. When people go to restaurants, they like to talk, but with that loud music, there's no way.

If you really want to improve your service, you need to invest in training, management and administration, because the way it is, you have no future.

If someone asks me if I recommend Marinato, of course I won't.

name: Barbara Fernandes
responseFromOwnerText:
Olá Barbara 
Sentimos muito por esse desconforto causado. Os molhos nós cobramos a parte realmente, você encontra essa informação no nosso menu na parte de “extras”. Em relação ao atendimento iremos investigar o que houve e tomaremos as devidas providências. Obrigada pelo seu feedback
text:
Minha terceira vez no restaurante e última. Todas as vezes tive algum “problema”
- A primeira pedi uma feijoada e veio só osso da costela dentro do feijão, comentei com o garçom ele respondeu “ deve ter soltado a carne no osso” uma lógica. E sim isso pode acontecer, mas é a questão de como abordar a situação.
- Segunda esperei 30min para ser atendida e toda vez que a garçonete passava na frente da minha mesa e fingia que não me escutava. Depois não ia ter mais tempo pedi para viagem, ela comentou que se chegasse cliente era pra sair da mesa. Pedi um sachê de ketchup e maionese ela falou que teria que pagar porque ser take way. Sendo que estava consumindo o produto.
- terceira vez . Cobraram pelos sachês sendo que eu estava consumindo no estabelecimento, ou seja não é cobrado por ser take way e sim porque cobram por algo que não tem sentido algum.
Para mim que sou Brasileira me sinto decepcionada e desapontada por ir em um lugar para sentir um pouco do nosso país é só ter decepções.
textTranslated:
My third time at the restaurant and last. Every time I had some “problem”
- The first time I ordered a feijoada and it only came with rib bones inside the beans, I told the waiter and he replied “the meat must have come loose on the bone” which is logical. And yes, this can happen, but it’s a question of how to approach the situation.
- The second time I waited 30 minutes to be served and every time the waitress passed in front of my table she pretended not to hear me. After that I didn’t have any more time and ordered take-out, she said that if a customer arrived they would have to leave the table. I asked for a sachet of ketchup and mayonnaise and she said I would have to pay for it because it was take-out. Even though I was consuming the product.
- The third time. They charged me for the sachets even though I was consuming it at the establishment, in other words, they didn’t charge me for it because it was take-out but because they charged me for something that makes no sense at all. For me, as a Brazilian, I feel disappointed and let down by going to a place to feel a little bit of our country and only having disappointments.

Don't bother getting food delivered from here, you will end up starving...
We had a movie night at home, so ordered food for delivery, they said it would be approx 35 mins. We live 5 mins drive from the branch, so after an hour waiting rang both, the branch and central customer services. After ringing the branch  (took about 15mins for them to pick the phone up), the guy said the food is on its way, it had left the restaurant about 2 mins before.
Meanwhile my bf kept holding on to customer services to provide some feedback. After another 10mins wait (about 25mins holding in total) he got through. Customer services also checked with the restaurant about the order and we were told that the food has NOT left the restaurant as its been busy. So we got different information and by that time were really hungry and rather frustrated. If we would have been informed about the delay or told that it was such a hassle getting it delivered, we would have gone to pick it up. As a result of the service received we told them not to bother with our order and refund the money. We ended up getting food from elsewhere.
Both, the false information provided (35mins should not be 1.5hr no matter what) and how the issue was handled has left us rather disappointed, havent experienced so rubbish service anywhere else. No more Nandos for a while, thats for sure.

We regreted going into the azzuri instead of pizza express. We opted for "authentic" italian only to be dissapointed. The only good thing about the azzuri is the decor and the fried squid starter.

I had the azzuri lasagna which was an utter shambles. It looked as though they microwaved a slice of lasagna from the morning and topped it off with lots of tomato puree to mask how old it was. The whole thing tasted like marinara sauce from subway.

Moving on to the seafood tagliatele;  the prawns were very rubbery, the mussels was basically just empty shells whilst the only saving grace was the squid.

We didnt even bother to finish eating the mains.  We would have been better of going tescos next door and buying two ready meals instead of the two dreadful mains. To compound the misery  of our evening at the azzuri, my other half started to feel unwell 10 minutes after leaving the establishment.

Overall i think it should just stick to selling pizzas instead of serving dreadful food masked as authentic italian cuisine.

Hungry after - it is not an adult portion.
Two of us ordered the seafood linguine and the other the chicken salad. The ‘linguine’ was spaghetti, a very poor sauce with minimal seafood. Admittedly I asked for no squid, however, my portion had a total of 2 overcooked and chewy prawns and 3 mussels, my mums was similar (this dish costs £14.50).
The salad that was ordered was covered in a sauce that was a bit off with a very small amount of very bland chicken, so my sister couldn’t finish it as it was so tasteless.
The service was incredibly slow, we had to ask for the bill twice before someone brought it.
I advised the staff of the poor food quality and service and the only thing offered from them was to change some of the food (this is 20 minutes after we finished eating), they did not offer any compensation or even a chat with the manager, nothing.
Overall an incredibly disappointing experience, would definitely not go back here and would not recommend. We all left hungry and felt it was a complete waste of money.

responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Luke

Thanks so much for the review, great to read the awesome feedback! Please note that the service charge goes directly to our staff
text:
Popped in for a quick spot of brunch on Saturday. The place has a nice ambience and the waiter was very friendly although it took a while for us to be acknowledged at the door.

We ordered the short rib benedict, salmon royale and polenta chips to share, as well as a coffee each. The food came quickly and all of the dishes tasted great. Short rib benedict was packed with flavour with a good hit of spice from the nduja hollandaise, and the salmon royale had a good serving of salmon and a delicious black garlic aioli. The polenta fries were exceptional, served with a delicious miso mayo. The portions were quite small though, both dishes served with only a single poached egg neither of which had a runny yolk. I feel that SW16 Kitchen has the potential to compete with some of the really great bougie brunch places in South London, but getting a poached egg right needs to be top if the agenda!

We did really enjoy the food but it is quite expensive, our bill came to over £40 in the end. Unfortunately SW16 has adopted the increasingly-common-in-London practice of adding on an automatic 12.5% service charge, which is a bit excessive for a 30 minute stop for brunch.

Not usually one to write negative reviews, but this place is a disappointing restaurant disguised behind an Instagrammably Clapham-ish facade.
A happy hour menu the serving staff were apparently unaware of. A table with a lamp that somehow managed to blind one of us whichever way we positioned it. 'Buratta' salad which turned up as a watery spoonful of curds atop some leaves. 'Disco bread' which is frankly an inedibly salty, crispy offence to bread itself that left us blaming ourselves for not asking what disco bread is in the first place.
Everything about this restaurant screams 'post it on the gram' rather than 'we care about good food and service'.
Didn't get any pasta, so maybe that's where all the chefs' energy goes. Would just love to see a bit more care and soul in these dishes.

Which is more of a quiet slot, as the hour went by the evening crowds were arriving which had a mix of people, families, friend gatherings and couples.

Guessing from the popularity of it to book, the location is on the high street and very close to Streatham Hill Station which leads you east towards Crystal Place or West to Balham and up to Victoria so it's a good spot if have further plans or coming from these locations.

Streatham we feel can be under rated but this place was a good example of why to visit and support businesses like this.

We will be coming again and with some pictures attached.

Solid A*****
